descricao_original: Membranes are present throughout the cell and serve multiple functions. They form a unique membrane at the cell surface (plasma membrane), surround the nucleus, and form membranous intracellular organelles, such as endoplasmic reticulum, mitochondria and vesicles. All these membranes are unit membranes, consisting of a phospholipid bilayer and protein; integral membrane proteins span the bilayer; peripheral proteins associate with the inner surface of the membrane.
